title: View Cluster
description: Definition of a View Cluster (VCLS) repository object. A view cluster groups multiple SVIM maintenance dialogs into a single hierarchical maintenance unit maintained via SM34 and SE54.

hierOperDepHandling.title: Hierarchical Operation Dependent Handling
hierOperDepHandling.description: Controls whether dependent sub-objects are included in hierarchical operations (copy, delete, undo, transport) and whether the user is prompted.
enumTitles: With Confirmation
Disabled
Automatic
enumDescriptions: Dependent entries will be processed with user confirmation via a popup
Hierarchical operations are performed without processing dependent objects
Dependent entries are automatically included and processed without user confirmation

dataReadType.title: Data Read Type
dataReadType.description: Controls whether all cluster objects are read at once or only the subtree relevant to the current navigation target (performance optimization for large clusters).
enumTitles: Complete
Subtree
enumDescriptions: All objects in the view cluster are read when data loading is triggered
Only the subtree containing the current navigation target is read

baseViewCluster.title: Base View Cluster
baseViewCluster.description: Name of the base view cluster this variant is derived from. Only relevant when this cluster is a variant derived from the base view cluster.

clusterLevels.title: Cluster Levels
clusterLevels.description: The objects (views or tables) participating in this cluster, their hierarchy, navigation behavior, and field dependency mappings

items.title: Cluster Level
items.description: One object (view or table) participating in the view cluster hierarchy. Each level defines its parent, navigation behavior, and field dependency mappings.

objectName.title: Object Name
objectName.description: Technical name of the DDIC view or table at this hierarchy level.

predecessorObject.title: Predecessor Object
predecessorObject.description: Parent object one level up. Equals object_name for root objects (self-reference). Drives all tree traversal, both downward recursion and upward root search.

position.title: Position
position.description: Display position within the cluster hierarchy. Must be unique within the cluster.

vcEntrySelectionType.title: View Cluster Entry Selection Type
vcEntrySelectionType.description: Defines how many parent entries must be marked to navigate into this cluster level.
enumTitles: Header
Multiple Selection
Single Selection
enumDescriptions: Root entry of the view cluster. No parent selection is required for navigation.
Multiple parent entries can be selected to navigate into this dependent object
Exactly one parent entry must be selected to navigate into this dependent object

isStartObject.title: Is Start Object
isStartObject.description: Marks the entry point shown when cluster maintenance opens. Exactly one level should have this set. BACK from the start object ends maintenance.

isSuppressed.title: Is Suppressed
isSuppressed.description: Hides this level from the navigation display. The level is still read and saved. Can be overridden at runtime by the Switch Framework or SSCUI adaptation.

hasNmCardinality.title: Has N:M Cardinality
hasNmCardinality.description: When true, multiple parent entries can point to the same dependent entry. The system checks for shared ownership before deleting or copying dependent entries.

switchId.title: Switch ID
switchId.description: Switch Framework switch name (SFW5). If set, the level is automatically suppressed when the switch status is OFF or STAND_BY at runtime.

objectTexts.title: Object Texts
objectTexts.description: Language-dependent labels for this cluster level. Overrides the DDIC short text when present.

items.title: Cluster Object Level Text
items.description: Language-dependent description of a cluster level object

language.title: Language
language.description: Language key for the object text

objectText.title: Object Text
objectText.description: Description for the cluster level objects Overrides the DDIC short text when present.

fieldDependencies.title: Field Dependencies
fieldDependencies.description: Field-level mappings between this level and its predecessor. Controls key propagation, selection list population, and hierarchical operation matching.

items.title: Field Dependency
items.description: Defines how a field in a dependent object receives its value from a predecessor object. Controls navigation and key propagation between cluster objects

objectField.title: Object Field
objectField.description: Field name in the dependent object that receives its value or constraint from the predecessor

predecessorObject.title: Predecessor Object
predecessorObject.description: The parent object that provides the value. Must be the root object for copySelectionCondition Type.

predecessorField.title: Predecessor Field
predecessorField.description: Field in the predecessor object whose current value is propagated to objectField. Blank for root self-reference rows.

dependencyType.title: Field Dependency Type
dependencyType.description: Classifies the type of field dependency and determines how it is used at runtime
